title: Zigzag Boarding
statement: Passengers are in a linked list L0 → L1 → … → Ln. Boarding goes first, last, second, second-to-last, and so on: L0 → Ln → L1 → Ln−1 → L2 → … Rearrange the nodes in place and return the head.

keyPoints: Find the middle with fast and slow pointers
Cut the list and reverse the second half
Weave the two halves, one node from each
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Copy the nodes into an array and relink from both ends: O(n) space

hints: The order alternates between the front and the back. How can you walk the back half forwards?
Split the list at the middle and reverse the second half.
Then take one node from each half in turn until the second half is used up.
